headline: SriLankan Airlines adds fuel surcharge to break even by March after $35mn first-half loss
summary: SriLankan Airlines is adding a small fuel surcharge to upcoming tickets to break even by March. Surging jet fuel prices caused a US$35 million loss in the first half of the year.
why: Airlines are highly exposed to jet fuel costs, which are a major operating expense, so fuel price spikes quickly erode profitability and drive surcharges.
